parsed.post: Discarding the 0.8566 run. It seems my previous best (0.8497) was superior and the recent attempt with MATRIX_LR=0.04 was a step backward in performance. I'll revert to my best config (ce285ad) and try a different approach: increasing DEPTH to 7 to see if higher capacity can push past 0.849.
